item.name: Authentication

request.description:
## 1.1 Register (Daftar Akun)

Endpoint: POST /auth/register

Deskripsi: Mendaftarkan pengguna baru (Mahasiswa, Client, atau Admin).

Body (form-data/x-www-form-urlencoded):

name: (string) Nama Lengkap

email: (string) Email Unik

password: (string) Minimal 6 karakter

role: (string) Pilihan: mahasiswa, client, atau admin

response.name: Register as Mahasiswa Succes
email has already been taken
Register as Client Succes
Register as Admin Succes
Register  required The name field.
Register  required The Email field.
Register  required The Name & Email field.
Register  required The Name & Email & Password field.
Register  required The Password field.

request.description:
## 1.2 Login (Masuk)

Endpoint: POST /auth/login

Deskripsi: Masuk untuk mendapatkan Token.

Body:

email: (string)

password: (string)

Response Sukses: Mengembalikan access_token yang wajib dipakai untuk request lain.

response.name: Login Succes
Login required The Password field.
Login  required The Email field.
Login  required The Email & Password field.

request.description:
## 1.3 Login Check (Me)  
Endpoint: GET /auth/me

Header: Authorization: Bearer

Deskripsi: Mengecek data user yang sedang login (berguna untuk Frontend menyimpan state user).

response.name: Login CHeck Succes
Login Check Unauthenticated

request.description:
## 1.4 Logout  
Endpoint: POST /auth/logout

Header: Authorization: Bearer

Deskripsi: Menghapus sesi token user.

response.name: Logout Succes
Logout Unauthenticated

request.description:
## 1.5 Update Profile  
Endpoint: POST /auth/update-profile

Header: Authorization: Bearer

Deskripsi: Mengupdate nama, email, atau foto profil.

Body:

name: (string)

photo: (file/image) Opsional
